title: API: Only expose what need to be exposed
body:
We should be explicit about what is exposed (and usable) versus what is not exposed. Either by exposing only what need to be exposed or by annotating private properties with `_`.

Example: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/160f32d2124a9bad68bad6682f82f69c786aec50/src/lib/InstantSearch.js#L71-L79
